title: Step a first-order model
scope: Explicit Euler for a supplied toy model

items.prompt: Model dy/dt=−1y+0, initial y=2. Use one explicit Euler step of h=0.1 s. Return the next y; do not use the exact exponential solution.
items.solution: y_next=y+h(−ky+u)=9/5. This is a numerical-model step, not a physical-accuracy claim.
